integrity: The universal proof exhausts all exponent patterns permitted by \(\Omega(n)\le5\). The finite verifier is corroborative only and is not used to infer the unbounded statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only solutions with \(\Omega(n)\le5\) and proves the sharp lower bound \(\Omega(n)\ge6\) outside the prime-square family. It does not classify all \(\Omega(n)=6\) solutions or higher multiplicity layers.
title: Prime squares exhaust the first five multiplicity layers of a prime-power-sum equation
